title: Gauntlet Cursor
description: Replace your cursor with a cool gauntlet sprite!
body:
## **OVERVIEW**

This resource pack is made for the [Cursors Extended](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-cursor) mod. It changes the cursor to look like the ones from old videogames.

## **WHAT DOES THIS ADD?**
This resource pack playfully integrates both static and animated cursor sprites in a medieval aesthetic to make your cursor nicer to look at. Refer to the gallery to see said sprites.

### **HOW TO USE**
You need to install the previously mentioned Cursors Extended mod, and plop the pack .zip into your resource pack directory.

# ENJOY!
